#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]

    NotAttempted,
    ExchangeRejected,
    ExchangeUncertain,
    PersistenceUncertain,
    SuccessorRetained,
    Promoted,
    PromotionCleanupPending,
    AlreadyPresent,
}
